about: Rules for suspect(): wording in hidden text that reads like an instruction to an AI. Groups run in order on lowercased, normalised text; the first match names the reason. ' ~ ' stands for a gap of up to five words within one sentence, ' ~~ ' for up to twelve; <NAME> is a part below. A signal for triage, not a verdict: English only, and paraphrases slip through.
